description: ai-crew auto mode: reminds the session to run the crew workflow for real coding tasks without the user typing /crew. Honoured only when auto_mode is true in config.

hooks.command: echo "[ai-crew auto] If auto_mode is on and this message asks to write/change/fix/migrate/review code that will touch project files, run the ai-crew:crew skill now (its Auto mode section decides depth and wording). continue + in-progress state = ai-crew:crew-resume. Questions, opinions, or a one-spot edit at a named file:line are answered directly. no crew / ไม่ต้องใช้ทีม / do it yourself = skip the crew."
